# URL regular expressions the link checker (muffet) skips, one per line.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Both link checks read this file: the preview check (preview-verification.yml,
# through the verify action's muffet-excludes input) and the production check
# (production-verification.yml, through .github/scripts/check-links.sh).
#
# Exclusions hide broken links. Never add one without finding out why the
# link fails first, and asking (see CLAUDE.md).

.*mailto:.*
.*linkedin\.com.*
.*hawaii\.edu.*
.*timeanddate\.com.*
.*reddit\.com.*
.*electronics-lab\.com.*
.*matrix\.to.*
.*tinytapeout\.com/chips/silicon-proven.*
.*siliconprawn\.org.*
.*rc2014\.co\.uk.*

# Crowd Supply (and buy.wafer.space, which redirects there) blocks automated
# fetches with 403s and bot challenges
^https?://(www\.)?crowdsupply\.com([/?#:]|$)
^https?://buy\.wafer\.space([/?#:]|$)
